text: The authors define ICM as searching for a set of labels that are logically consistent and mutually predictable according to the pretrained model, where mutual predictability measures how likely the model infers each label when conditioned on all other labels, which encourages the labels to reflect a single concept. Logical consistency blocks superficially predictable assignments such as giving every point the same label, and because exact maximization is computationally infeasible, ICM uses a search inspired by simulated annealing.
title: ICM objective: mutual predictability plus logical consistency, simulated-annealing search
